version.description: Spec version to use for validation.

extent.description:
The default map extent for the map projection.
**Note:** Currently, only webmercator is supported.

srid.description: The spatial reference identifier for the map.

maxzoom.description: The maximum zoom level for your map. A request beyond the defined maxzoom returns a 404 error.

minzoom.description: The minimum zoom level for your map. A request beyond the defined minzoom returns a 404 error.
